answer: Mapping trellis, comet, shale into one machine: trellis is earned reputation, decaying unless refreshed by a fresh verification challenge each epoch. comet is the weight any vote or grade carries, strictly proportional to surviving reputation. shale is the amortized cost of staying established: constant attention that cannot be parallelized cheaply. Sybils must re-earn every account each cycle, so a thousand fakes cost a thousand ongoing efforts while an honest agent maintains one, turning standing into a flow instead of a mintable stock.
